units.name: M1A2 SEPv3 Abrams
units.advantage: Depleted uranium composite armor matrix and Trophy Active Protection System (APS) defeat incoming anti-tank guided missiles.
units.disadvantage: High fuel consumption from AGT1500 g.
units.description: The pinnacle of American armored combat: 120mm M256A1 smoothbore cannon, CROWS-J Javelin mount, and joint tactical radio network.

units.name: Leopard 2A7+ Heavy MBT
units.advantage: Rheinmetall 120mm L/55 high-pressure gun delivering extreme muzzle velocity with DM63/DM73 kinetic penetrators.
units.disadvantage: Large physical silhouette and high weight limiting traverse across secondary bridges.
units.description: The standard of NATO armored doctrine, featuring 360-degree modular passive armor, PERI R17A3 hunter-killer sights, and auxiliary power unit.

units.name: Challenger 3 Armored Dreadnought
units.advantage: Next-generation Epsom and Farnham modular composite armor, unmatched hull-down defilade survivability.
units.disadvantage: Lower cross-country top speed compared to lighter MBT counterparts.
units.description: British Army digital vanguard equipped with Rheinmetall L55A1 smoothbore cannon, fully digitized turret, and Trophy MV APS.

units.name: K2 Black Panther
units.advantage: In-arm hydropneumatic suspension kneels and tilts for extreme elevation angles in mountainous defilade.
units.disadvantage: Complex suspension requiring higher maintenance frequency in sub-zero mud environments.
units.description: High-tech South Korean flagship featuring CN08 120mm/L55 autoloader (10 rounds/min), millimeter-band radar, and KSTAM top-attack munitions.

units.name: Leclerc XLR SCORPION
units.advantage: Rapid pneumatic bustle autoloader firing 12 rounds per minute on the move at full speed.
units.disadvantage: Slightly lighter side armor profile than Abrams or Challenger series.
units.description: French Army mechanized jewel upgraded under the SCORPION program with vetronics, hyperbar diesel engine, and Galix defense system.

units.name: Type 10 Hitomaru
units.advantage: Nano-crystal ceramic-steel armor and active C4I tactical networking enabling shared targeting across the company.
units.disadvantage: Lighter 44-ton gross combat weight trades maximum kinetic armor volume for bridge mobility.
units.description: Japan Ground Self-Defense Force 4th-generation MBT featuring continuously variable transmission and domestic 120mm smoothbore gun.

units.name: Merkava Mk 4M Windbreaker
units.advantage: Front-mounted diesel engine block provides extra crew survivability; rear hull clam-shell door allows casualty evacuation.
units.disadvantage: Massive front thermal signature and high combat weight.
units.description: Israeli urban combat fortress with combat-proven Trophy Active Protection System, 120mm MG253 gun, and internal 60mm mortar.

units.name: T-90M Proryv-3 Breaker
units.advantage: Relikt 3rd-generation Explosive Reactive Armor (ERA) and 9M119M Refleks gun-launched laser-guided anti-tank missiles.
units.disadvantage: Carousel autoloader beneath crew compartment vulnerable if hull floor is breached.
units.description: Deeply modernized armored platform with 125mm 2A46M-5 smoothbore gun, Kalina digital fire-control, and anti-fragmentation netting.

units.name: Stridsvagn 122+ Northern Shield
units.advantage: Heavy reinforced top-attack turret armor specifically engineered against anti-tank bomblets and loitering munitions.
units.disadvantage: Higher overall weight demanding specialized sub-arctic tracked recovery vehicles.
units.description: Swedish Army modernized Leopard 2 variant featuring GALAX multispectral smoke projectors, French C2 command system, and all-weather thermals.

units.name: C1 Ariete PSO
units.advantage: Peace Support Operation (PSO) modular composite side skirt package and TURMS-F digital fire control.
units.disadvantage: Lower base hull composite thickness without the add-on armor package installed.
units.description: Italian Army main combat vehicle armed with Oto Melara 120mm 44-caliber smoothbore gun and Iveco V12 turbocharged diesel.

units.name: MIM-104 Patriot PAC-3 MSE
units.advantage: Hit-to-Kill kinetic ballistic missile defense interceptor with attitude control thrusters for extreme terminal agility.
units.disadvantage: Heavy stationary deployment footprint with slow redeployment time.
units.description: Premier air and ballistic missile defense system: AN/MPQ-65 active phased array tracking radar paired with 16 MSE canister missiles.

units.name: M142 HIMARS Rocket Artillery
units.advantage: Extreme shoot-and-scoot capability; launches 6 GPS-guided M31 GMLRS rockets or deep-strike ATACMS in seconds.
units.disadvantage: Vulnerable to counter-battery fires during the 5-minute reloading cycle.
units.description: High-mobility wheeled precision rocket artillery delivering GPS-guided submunitions and unitary warheads deep behind enemy lines.

units.name: S-400 Triumf Long-Range Battery
units.advantage: Multi-layered 40N6 and 48N6DM hypersonic interceptors reaching speeds exceeding Mach 6 out to 400km.
units.disadvantage: High electronic radar emissions make the search radar vulnerable to anti-radiation missiles.
units.description: Theater air-defense complex with 91N6E panoramic acquisition radar and four-canister TEL trucks for comprehensive aerospace defense.

units.name: NSM Coastal Defense Battery
units.advantage: Sea-skimming stealth profile and Autonomous Target Recognition (ATR) optical seeker that ignores electronic countermeasures.
units.disadvantage: Subsonic flight profile requires terrain masking to avoid modern short-range naval CIWS.
units.description: Norwegian truck-mounted 5th-generation anti-ship missile system capable of precision land and maritime strike in littoral corridors.

units.name: BGM-109 Tomahawk Mobile TEL
units.advantage: TERCOM terrain-contour matching and two-way satellite datalink allowing in-flight re-targeting against fortified command nodes.
units.disadvantage: Lower rate of fire and high unit replacement cost per cruise missile fired.
units.description: Ground-based Tomahawk cruise missile launcher delivering 1,000-pound high-explosive warheads against high-value strategic targets.

units.name: NASAMS 3 High Mobility Launcher
units.advantage: Dispersed networked architecture; the radar and fire distribution center operate miles away from the canister launchers.
units.disadvantage: Limited terminal defense against ultra-high velocity ballistic missiles.
units.description: Network-centric medium-range air defense system firing AIM-120 AMRAAM-ER and AIM-9X Sidewinder interceptors.

units.name: IRIS-T SLM Medium-Range SAM
units.advantage: Imaging Infrared (IIR) terminal seeker with thrust-vectoring steering that is completely immune to radar RF jamming.
units.disadvantage: Requires cloud-free or thermal line-of-sight in extreme weather terminal engagements.
units.description: German precision air defense launcher mounted on 8x8 MAN chassis with TRML-4D AESA radar, scoring exceptional intercept rates.

units.name: 9K720 Iskander-M Ballistic Battery
units.advantage: Quasi-ballistic maneuvering flight trajectory with optical scene-matching terminal guidance and penetration decoys.
units.disadvantage: Only two missiles carried per TEL vehicle before complete crane reload required.
units.description: Short-range theater ballistic missile system capable of Mach 6 hypersonic terminal dive against hardened underground bunkers.

units.name: Iron Dome Tamir C-RAM Battery
units.advantage: Rapid multi-target simultaneous interception of incoming artillery shells, rockets, and low-observable attack drones.
units.disadvantage: High missile consumption when faced with mass saturation rocket barrages.
units.description: Combat-proven Counter-Rocket, Artillery, and Mortar system utilizing EL/M-2084 MMR radar and Tamir electro-optical fuzed interceptors.

units.name: BrahMos Mobile Supersonic Battery
units.advantage: Mach 3.0 supersonic cruise speed driven by ramjet engine imparts massive kinetic energy upon surface and shore targets.
units.disadvantage: Large missile dimensions restrict mobile TEL payload to three cylindrical launch canisters.
units.description: Autonomous coastal defense and precision surface strike launcher firing ramjet-powered supersonic cruise missiles with 300kg warheads.

units.name: F-22A Raptor Air Dominance
units.advantage: All-aspect low radar observability and Pratt & Whitney F119 supercruise at Mach 1.82 without afterburners.
units.disadvantage: Internal weapon bay capacity limits maximum ordnance volume.
units.description: The world benchmark in 5th-generation air superiority: 2D thrust-vectoring nozzles, AN/APG-77 AESA radar, and internal AIM-120D bays.

units.name: F-35A Lightning II Strike Fighter
units.advantage: Electro-Optical Distributed Aperture System (DAS) providing 360-degree spherical vision and sensor fusion directly to pilot helmet.
units.disadvantage: Stealth coating maintenance demands specialized climate-controlled hangar facilities.
units.description: Multi-role stealth strike fighter: AN/APG-81 AESA radar, internal 25mm GAU-22/A Gatling cannon, and networked joint strike datalink.

units.name: Eurofighter Typhoon Tranche 4
units.advantage: Extreme canard-delta agility in dogfights and long-range ramjet Meteor Beyond-Visual-Range Air-to-Air Missiles (BVRAAM).
units.disadvantage: Non-stealth airframe relies on active electronic jamming rather than low radar cross-section.
units.description: European swing-role fighter powered by dual EJ200 turbofans, Captor-E AESA radar, and PIRATE infrared search-and-track system.

units.name: Dassault Rafale C Omnirole
units.advantage: SPECTRA internal electronic warfare suite detects, classifies, and neutralizes hostile radar emitters automatically.
units.disadvantage: High procurement cost per airframe and specialized ordnance requirements.
units.description: French twin-engine omnirole strike fighter armed with RBE2 active radar, 30mm GIAT 30M791 cannon, and SCALP-EG standoff cruise missiles.

units.name: F-15EX Eagle II Heavy Striker
units.advantage: Massive weapons carriage capacity: carries up to 29,500 pounds of air-to-air and precision air-to-ground ordnance.
units.disadvantage: Large conventional radar cross-section detectable by long-range ground-based search radars.
units.description: Modernized heavy air superiority platform featuring fly-by-wire flight control, EPAWSS electronic warfare, and Mach 2.5 top speed.

units.name: Su-57 Felon 5th-Gen Stealth
units.advantage: 3D all-axis thrust vectoring allows post-stall Pugachev Cobra and Kulbit aerobatic maneuvers impossible for conventional jets.
units.disadvantage: Limited production volume and complex maintenance logistics for the Saturn AL-41F1 engines.
units.description: 5th-generation stealth combat aircraft featuring Sh121 radar suite with Byelka cheek-mounted AESA arrays and internal tandem weapon bays.

units.name: A-10C Thunderbolt II "Warthog"
units.advantage: Titanium armor bathtub protects the pilot from 23mm anti-aircraft flak; redundant hydraulic and mechanical flight controls.
units.disadvantage: Slow cruising speed makes the aircraft vulnerable to modern high-altitude radar-guided surface-to-air missiles.
units.description: Close Air Support legend built around the 30mm GAU-8/A Avenger Gatling cannon firing 3,900 depleted uranium rounds per minute.

units.name: Su-35S Flanker-E Interceptor
units.advantage: Irbis-E passive electronically scanned array (PESA) radar tracks up to 30 airborne targets simultaneously at 400km.
units.disadvantage: Lack of stealth airframe shaping limits survival in contested Western-integrated air defense zones.
units.description: Super-maneuverable air superiority fighter with AL-41F1S thrust-vectoring turbofans and 12 wing pylons for R-77-1 and R-37M missiles.

units.name: JAS 39E Gripen Foxhound Hunter
units.advantage: Dispersed road-base operations; can rearm and refuel on ordinary 800m civilian highways in under ten minutes.
units.disadvantage: Single General Electric F414G engine provides lower payload limits than dual-engine heavy fighters.
units.description: Swedish multirole aircraft engineered for network warfare, equipped with Raven ES-05 AESA radar and electronic attack pods.

units.name: B-21 Raider Stealth Penetrator
units.advantage: Next-generation broadband radar absorption and digital open architecture, invisible to low-frequency search radars.
units.disadvantage: Subsonic strategic bomber requiring dedicated fighter escort in unexpected close-in visual air encounters.
units.description: Long-range penetrating strike stealth bomber capable of delivering both conventional precision standoff munitions and direct penetrators.

units.name: AH-64E Apache Guardian
units.advantage: Mast-mounted APG-78 Longbow millimeter-wave radar acquires 128 targets through smoke and rain behind terrain defilade.
units.disadvantage: Complex dual-engine powertrain requires intensive forward arming and refueling point (FARP) maintenance.
units.description: The world standard in tandem attack aviation: 16 AGM-114 Hellfire laser/radar missiles and 30mm M230 chain gun slaved to pilot eye helmet.

units.name: Ka-52 Alligator Attack Gunship
units.advantage: Coaxial contra-rotating dual main rotors eliminate the tail rotor, granting exceptional hover stability in 30-knot crosswinds.
units.disadvantage: Side-by-side cockpit arrangement gives a wider frontal cross-section than traditional tandem cockpits.
units.description: Heavily armored reconnaissance gunship featuring K-37-800 ejection seats, Arbalet radar in nose radome, and 12 Vikhr-1 ATGM tubes.

units.name: Mi-28NM Night Hunter
units.advantage: Heavy titanium cockpit tub and ceramic armor deflect direct 12.7mm and 20mm cannon rounds; spherical mast radar.
units.disadvantage: Heavier empty weight slightly reduces operational service ceiling in hot-and-high desert conditions.
units.description: Dedicated all-weather tank destroyer armed with 30mm 2A42 dual-feed autocannon and Ataka-V radio-guided anti-tank missiles.

units.name: Eurocopter Tiger HAD
units.advantage: Eighty percent carbon-fiber and Kevlar composite airframe reduces radar cross-section and acoustic rotor noise signature.
units.disadvantage: Lighter ballistic armor protection compared to heavy gunships like Apache or Havoc.
units.description: Franco-German multi-role gunship equipped with roof-mounted gyro-stabilized sights, 30mm GIAT 30M781 turret, and Spike-ER missiles.

units.name: AH-1Z Viper Marine Gunship
units.advantage: Target Sight System (TSS) provides third-generation FLIR identification at extreme visual ranges; wingtip AIM-9 Sidewinder air defense.
units.disadvantage: Smaller cabin footprint limits future avionics retrofit expansion without weight reallocation.
units.description: United States Marine Corps twin-engine attack helicopter with 4-blade composite rotor system and nose-mounted 20mm M197 Gatling gun.

units.name: MH-60M DAP Black Hawk Gunship
units.advantage: 160th Special Operations Aviation Regiment (Night Stalkers) configuration carrying dual 30mm chain guns and 70mm Hydra pods.
units.disadvantage: Non-dedicated attack profile gives a larger profile to ground-based anti-aircraft fire.
units.description: Direct Action Penetrator (DAP) armed conversion of the MH-60M Black Hawk, providing escort and heavy gunship fires for assault forces.

units.name: AW129 Mangusta Combat Gunship
units.advantage: High agility and narrow fuselage profile allow rapid nap-of-the-earth ridgeline masking and quick breakaway turns.
units.disadvantage: Lighter payload capacity (8 TOW/Spike missiles maximum compared to 16 on heavy gunships).
units.description: First dedicated attack helicopter designed in Western Europe, featuring Oto Melara 20mm three-barrel nose gun and digital avionics.

units.name: CH-47F Armed Assault Chinook
units.advantage: Immense twin-tandem rotor lift capacity; armored cabin with triple pintle-mounted M134 7.62mm miniguns and .50-cal ramp gun.
units.disadvantage: Massive acoustic and visual signature prevents surprise approaches.
units.description: Heavy assault transport outfitted with ballistic floor armor plates and door-gunner arrays to suppress landing zones under fire.

units.name: Harbin Z-10 Attack Gunship
units.advantage: Narrow tandem armored cockpit with stealth angled fuselage chine and helmet-mounted optical thermal tracking.
units.disadvantage: Slightly lower engine thrust-to-weight reserve at maximum combat payload in high altitude.
units.description: Modern tandem attack helicopter armed with 23mm revolving nose cannon and stub-wing pylons for HJ-10 fiber-optic ATGMs.

units.name: MH-6M Little Bird "Killer Egg"
units.advantage: Unmatched agility; can insert Special Forces onto rooftops and weave through city streets between buildings.
units.disadvantage: Minimal ballistic armor protection; relies entirely on speed, darkness, and pilot skill.
units.description: Light special operations assault gunship armed with twin M134 7.62mm miniguns and dual 7-tube 2.75-inch folding-fin rocket pods.

units.name: Arleigh Burke Flight III Destroyer
units.advantage: AN/SPY-6(V)1 AMDR active phased array radar with 35 times greater radar sensitivity and 96 Mk 41 VLS cells.
units.disadvantage: High maintenance cost and crew requirements typical of heavy 9,500-ton guided missile destroyers.
units.description: United States Navy premier surface combatant: Aegis Baseline 10 combat system, 5-inch/62 Mk 45 naval gun, and Phalanx CIWS.

units.name: Type 055 Guided Missile Destroyer
units.advantage: 112 large universal vertical launch cells firing supersonic anti-ship and long-range air defense missiles in dense volleys.
units.disadvantage: Large 13,000-ton displacement makes the vessel a prime high-priority target for coordinated submarine wolfpacks.
units.description: Heavy stealth-profile guided missile warship with dual-band S/X AESA radar suite and 130mm H/PJ-38 naval gun turret.

units.name: Constellation-Class Guided Frigate
units.advantage: Next-gen EASR 3D radar and 16 Naval Strike Missile box launchers combined with quiet hybrid electric drive for anti-submarine warfare.
units.disadvantage: Smaller 32-cell VLS magazine compared to full-size guided missile destroyers.
units.description: United States Navy new multi-mission guided missile frigate class, armed with Bofors 57mm Mk 110 gun and CAPTAS-4 variable depth sonar.

units.name: Type 45 Daring-Class Destroyer
units.advantage: SAMPSON multi-function radar tracking hundreds of air targets simultaneously; PAAMS Sea Viper 48-cell missile system.
units.disadvantage: WR-21 g-temperature equatorial waters.
units.description: Royal Navy primary air defense warship, capable of defending aircraft carrier battle groups against saturation missile attacks.

units.name: Ticonderoga-Class Missile Cruiser
units.advantage: 122 Mk 41 VLS strike cells and dual 5-inch naval deck guns; serves .
units.disadvantage: Aging hull infrastructure requiring higher operational shipyard maintenance.
units.description: Historic workhorse of US Navy fleet defense: twin SPY-1B phased array radars and massive Tomahawk/Standard Missile arsenal.

units.name: Admiral Gorshkov Stealth Frigate
units.advantage: Carries 3M22 Zircon hypersonic cruise missiles capable of Mach 8-9 flight, impossible for conventional naval point-defense guns to intercept.
units.disadvantage: Smaller 4,500-ton displacement restricts endurance in sustained heavy North Atlantic sea states.
units.description: Modern Russian Navy lead frigate with Poliment-Redut vertical air defense and 130mm A-192M automated naval gun.

units.name: Visby-Class Stealth Corvette
units.advantage: Carbon-fiber reinforced polymer hull with extreme stealth geometry; virtually invisible on enemy maritime surveillance radars.
units.disadvantage: Absence of long-range area air defense; relies on point-defense and evasive coastal maneuvering.
units.description: Swedish Navy littoral combat marvel: concealed Bofors 57mm Mk3 gun, 8 RBS-15 Mk2 anti-ship missiles, and Saab 9LV combat system.

units.name: Bergamini-Class FREMM Frigate
units.advantage: KRONOS Grand Naval 3D AESA radar paired with Aster 30 missiles and twin Oto Melara 76/62mm Davide CIWS.
units.disadvantage: Compact frigate displacement limits total VLS cell capacity to 32 Sylver vertical launch tubes.
units.description: Marina Militare multi-mission frontline frigate armed with Otomat Mk-2/E anti-ship missiles and variable depth active sonar.

units.name: Canberra-Class Amphibious Escort
units.advantage: Large flight deck and well dock capable of launching combat helicopters, landing craft, and armored vehicles simultaneously.
units.disadvantage: Large high-freeboard profile makes it dependent on guided missile destroyers for long-range air defense.
units.description: Royal Australian Navy flagship multi-role landing helicopter dock, protected by dual Phalanx 20mm CIWS and Rafael Typhoon mounts.

units.name: Iver Huitfeldt-Class Air Defense
units.advantage: Thales APAR 3D active phased array radar and SMART-L long-range search radar providing continuous target illumination for 32 Mk 41 VLS cells.
units.disadvantage: Lower top sprint speed compared to pure turbine-powered destroyers.
units.description: High-capability air defense frigate equipped with Oto Melara 76mm guns, Oerlikon Millennium 35mm CIWS, and Harpoon missile batteries.

units.name: Virginia-Class Fast Attack Sub
units.advantage: Virginia Payload Module (VPM) carries 28 Tomahawk cruise missiles; anechoic rubber acoustic tile stealth makes it nearly undetectable undersea.
units.disadvantage: Requires deep water ocean corridors for maximum high-speed silent submerged transit.
units.description: United States Navy premier nuclear-powered fast-attack submarine equipped with spherical active/passive sonar array, photonics masts, and heavyweight Mk 48 ADCAP torpedoes.

units.name: Astute-Class Nuclear Attack Sub
units.advantage: Sonar 2076 processing suite h.
units.disadvantage: Extreme engineering complexity demands specialized submarine base maintenance infrastructure.
units.description: Royal Navy cutting-edge nuclear hunter-killer sub equipped with Spearfish wire-guided torpedoes and Tomahawk Block V cruise missiles.

units.name: Yasen-M Guided Missile Submarine
units.advantage: Eight vertical launch silos carrying 32 Kalibr cruise or Oniks supersonic anti-ship missiles, combined with conformal flank sonar arrays.
units.disadvantage: Larger 13,800-ton submerged displacement produces greater hydrodynamic wake when maneuvering at high speed.
units.description: Fourth-generation nuclear guided missile submarine featuring low-magnetic steel hull and automated nuclear reactor plant.

units.name: Type 212A AIP Stealth Submarine
units.advantage: Hydrogen fuel-cell Air-Independent Propulsion (AIP) allows 3 weeks of silent submerged operations with zero exhaust heat and non-magnetic hull.
units.disadvantage: Smaller diesel-electric hull displacement limits torpedo magazine capacity compared to nuclear fleet submarines.
units.description: German Navy stealth hunter-killer submarine constructed of non-magnetic austenitic steel to defeat magnetic anomaly detectors (MAD), armed with DM2A4 Seehecht torpedoes.

units.name: Scorpène-Class Attack Submarine
units.advantage: SUBTICS automated tactical integrated combat system and SM39 submarine-launched Exocet anti-ship missiles.
units.disadvantage: Moderate sustained sprint speed compared to larger nuclear-powered submarines.
units.description: French Naval Group ocean-patrol diesel-electric attack submarine equipped with 6 bow torpedo tubes firing F21 heavyweight torpedoes.

units.name: Gotland-Class AIP Hunter-Killer
units.advantage: Stirling AIP propulsion system is famously silent—famously "sank" a US supercarrier in simulated wargame war exercises without detection.
units.disadvantage: Optimized for shallow brackish littoral waters rather than deep trans-oceanic combat patrols.
units.description: Swedish Navy premier littoral stealth submarine armed with Torped 62 heavy wire-guided acoustic homing torpedoes.

units.name: Taigei-Class Lithium-Ion Sub
units.advantage: High-density Lithium-ion battery bank delivers unprecedented underwater burst speed and rapid electrical recharging.
units.disadvantage: Requires rigorous thermal management protocols for lithium battery banks under heavy combat drain.
units.description: Japan Maritime Self-Defense Force stealth submarine armed with Type 18 heavyweight acoustic-homing torpedoes and Harpoon missiles.

units.name: KSS-III Dosan Ahn Changho Sub
units.advantage: Equipped with 6 vertical launch system (VLS) cells capable of launching Hyunmoo-4-4 submarine-launched ballistic missiles (SLBMs).
units.disadvantage: Heavy 3,750-ton submerged displacement increases hydrodynamic turning radius.
units.description: Republic of Korea Navy strategic attack submarine with indigenously designed fuel-cell AIP and Tiger Shark heavy torpedoes.

units.name: Ohio-Class Guided Missile SSGN
units.advantage: Carries an astonishing 154 BGM-109 Tomahawk cruise missiles, capable of single-handedly neutralizing entire enemy naval bases or coastal defenses.
units.disadvantage: Massive 18,750-ton hull requires immense open deep-ocean operating room and deep harbor docking facilities.
units.description: Converted nuclear submarine strike platform featuring dual dry-deck shelters for Navy SEAL special operations delivery.

units.name: Todaro-Class U212A Silent Sub
units.advantage: Amagnetic steel hull and hydrogen fuel-cell AIP allow completely noiseless coastal ambushes in Mediterranean choke points.
units.disadvantage: Limited internal weapons bay payload compared to fleet nuclear submarines.
units.description: Italian Navy fuel-cell submarine equipped with Black Shark advanced heavyweight fiber-optic guided torpedoes.

units.name: MQ-9A Reaper Hunter-Killer
units.advantage: MTS-B electro-optical/infrared sensor turret with laser rangefinder and 27-hour combat loitering endurance.
units.disadvantage: Subsonic propeller cruising speed leaves it vulnerable to advanced long-range surface-to-air missiles.
units.description: Premier Medium-Altitude Long-Endurance (MALE) strike UCAV armed with 4 AGM-114 Hellfire laser-guided missiles and dual GBU-12 laser bombs.

units.name: Bayraktar TB2 Strike UCAV
units.advantage: Exceptional cost-to-effect ratio, carbon-fiber composite inverted V-tail, and proven radar-evading tactical loitering.
units.disadvantage: Light airframe cannot sustain close-proximity anti-aircraft artillery flak.
units.description: Renowned tactical strike drone armed with 4 Roketsan MAM-L laser-guided smart micro-munitions capable of top-attack armor penetration.

units.name: RQ-4 Global Hawk High-Altitude UAV
units.advantage: Operates at 60,000 feet altitude for over 32 hours, transmitting real-time synthetic aperture radar (SAR) target feeds to all friendly forces.
units.disadvantage: Unarmed reconnaissance and electronic targeting platform; relies on friendly missile batteries and jets to deliver terminal firepower.
units.description: High-Altitude Long-Endurance (HALE) autonomous strategic drone equipped with battlefield laser designators and SIGINT intercept arrays.

units.name: Switchblade 600 Anti-Armor Drone
units.advantage: Man-portable tube-launched loitering kamikaze munition with Javelin tandem anti-armor warhead for lethal top-attack dives.
units.disadvantage: Single-use expendable munition with maximum 40-minute loiter flight time.
units.description: Tactical loitering munition system featuring high-resolution gimbal cameras, wave-off capability, and fly-by-wire terminal homing.

units.name: XQ-58A Valkyrie Stealth Wingman
units.advantage: Stealth runway-independent rocket-assisted launch with autonomous AI swarm coordination and internal bomb bay.
units.disadvantage: Requires high-bandwidth encrypted AI datalinks to reach maximum autonomous swarm lethality.
units.description: Low-cost attritable unmanned combat aerial vehicle (UCAV) designed to fly alongside F-35 and F-22 fighters -guided escort.

units.name: Heron TP Strategic Combat Drone
units.advantage: 14-meter wingspan turboprop carrying 1,000 kg payload of standoff electro-optical sensors and precision glide bombs.
units.disadvantage: Large radar signature compared to modern tailless flying-wing stealth drones.
units.description: Israel Aerospace Industries flagship all-weather MALE combat drone with satellite communications for intercontinental operations.

units.name: Shahed-136 Loitering Interceptor
units.advantage: Delta-wing pusher propeller design with 50 kg high-explosive fragmentation warhead and autonomous inertial/satellite guidance.
units.disadvantage: Lacks real-time camera return once committed to its pre-programmed dive profile.
units.description: Long-range autonomous loitering attack munition launched from vehicle-mounted multi-pack racks to swarm defensive perimeters.

units.name: MQ-25 Stingray Carrier Drone
units.advantage: First carrier-based autonomous unmanned aircraft, extending carrier strike air wing radius by over 500 nautical miles.
units.disadvantage: Primary mission is tactical aerial refueling and surveillance, with secondary strike capability.
units.description: US Navy catapult-launched autonomous stealth combat drone engineered by Boeing for aircraft carrier flight-deck operations.

units.name: TAI Anka-3 Flying-Wing Stealth
units.advantage: Tailless flying-wing geometry with zero vertical stabilizers, rendering it nearly invisible to high-frequency fire control radars.
units.disadvantage: Requires complex fly-by-wire computerized pitch and yaw control surfaces due to aerodynamically unstable flying-wing design.
units.description: Turkish Aerospace Industries next-generation deep-strike stealth UCAV featuring twin internal weapons bays carrying Mk-82 and SOM-J cruise missiles.

units.name: Warmate Micro-Loitering Drone
units.advantage: Can be deployed from infantry backpacks or vehicle roof canisters in less than two minutes; features interchangeable HEAT and thermobaric warheads.
units.disadvantage: Ultra-light airframe is susceptible to high crosswinds during terminal attack dives.
units.description: Polish WB Group tube-launched precision strike loitering munition with automated target acquisition and high-g dive attack.

units.name: M2A4 Bradley IFV
units.advantage: Dual TOW-2B missile launcher with top-attack warheads and Bushmaster 25mm chain gun.
units.disadvantage: Tracked profile demands frequent road wheel and shoe maintenance.
units.description: American mechanized combat staple with upgraded suspension, digital vetronics, and TOW capability.

units.name: Challenger 2 TES Megatron
units.advantage: Chobham/Dorchester Level 2 armor with explosive reactive armor tiles along the hull sides.
units.disadvantage: Rifled 120mm L30A1 gun uses unique two-piece ammunition incompatible with smoothbore NATO ammo.
units.description: British main battle tank famous for its legendary armor protection in heavy urban combat.

units.name: Navy SEAL Recon Breacher
units.advantage: Exceptional stealth factor; designates targets for airstrikes with SOFLAM laser illuminators.
units.disadvantage: Dismounted infantry vulnerability against heavy high-explosive artillery barrages.
units.description: Elite Tier-1 special operations reconnaissance operator armed with suppressed sniper weapons and laser markers.

units.name: Panzerhaubitze 2000 155mm
units.advantage: Multiple Rounds Simultaneous Impact (MRSI): fires five rounds in different arcs landing simultaneously.
units.disadvantage: High ammunition consumption requires dedicated accompanying ammunition carriers.
units.description: The pinnacle of armored artillery: automated shell loading, chrome-lined 52-caliber barrel, and 54km range.

units.name: CAESAR 155mm Wheeled Artillery
units.advantage: Rapid shoot-and-scoot; unlimbers, fires six rounds in under a minute, and drives away before counter-battery.
units.disadvantage: Lightly armored truck chassis provides minimal protection against heavy fragmentation.
units.description: French 6x6/8x8 wheeled self-propelled 155mm howitzer renowned for extreme combat mobility.

units.name: Archer 155mm Artillery System
units.advantage: Fully automated magazine and loading; entire fire mission executed from inside an armored cab.
units.disadvantage: Requires flat terrain for high-rate firing stability.
units.description: Swedish automated self-propelled gun system mounted on articulated all-terrain hauler.

units.name: Gepard 1A2 Dual 35mm SPAAG
units.advantage: Twin 35mm Oerlikon autocannons firing 1,100 rounds/min with AHEAD programmable airburst ammunition.
units.disadvantage: Effective engagement ceiling limited to 4,000 meters compared to high-altitude SAMs.
units.description: Dual-radar self-propelled anti-aircraft gun with exceptional performance against low-flying cruise missiles and drones.

units.name: KSK Tactical Sapper
units.advantage: High demolition charges and night-vision target painting behind enemy lines.
units.disadvantage: Vulnerable in open terrain without vehicular or smoke cover.
units.description: Kommando Spezialkräfte operative specialized in clandestine sabotage and laser-guided airstrike targeting.

units.name: Type 16 Maneuver Combat Vehicle
units.advantage: 105mm rifled cannon on an 8x8 wheeled chassis traveling at 100 km/h over highway networks.
units.disadvantage: Wheels vulnerable to heavy fragmentation compared to heavy tank tracks.
units.description: Japanese rapid-deployment wheeled tank destroyer capable of air-transport in C-2 aircraft.

units.name: LAV 6.0 Reconnaissance
units.advantage: Surveillance mast with radar, thermal, and daylight camer.
units.disadvantage: High profile makes it easier for hostile tank gunners to spot in open fields.
units.description: Canadian Army 8x8 armored reconnaissance vehicle with 25mm M242 Bushmaster cannon.

units.name: Boxer Combat Recon Vehicle
units.advantage: Lance 30mm turret with Spike-LR2 anti-tank guided missiles and modular mission drive capsule.
units.disadvantage: Large 38-ton wheeled weight requires solid road surfaces.
units.description: Australian Army premier armored reconnaissance vehicle featuring high survivability and modular mission modules.

units.name: Bushmaster Protected Breacher
units.advantage: V-shaped monocoque hull deflects landmine and IED blasts away from the crew compartment.
units.disadvantage: Only armed with remote weapon station machine guns; limited heavy anti-tank punch.
units.description: Australian combat-proven infantry mobility vehicle with exceptional mine blast survivability.

units.name: JTF2 Arctic Long-Range Sniper
units.advantage: .50-cal McMillan TAC-50 rifle precision out to 3,500 meters in extreme sub-zero winds.
units.disadvantage: Bolt-action fire rate demands long re-aiming intervals.
units.description: Elite Canadian special forces sniper holding world-record confirmed long-distance sniper engagements.

units.name: K30 Biho Flying Tiger SPAAG
units.advantage: Twin 30mm cannons paired with quad Chiron short-range surface-to-air missile pods.
units.disadvantage: Radar search radius requires stationary operations for optimal tracking.
units.description: South Korean air defense system combining optical tracking with rapid-fire 30mm cannons and fire-and-forget missiles.

units.name: Stugna-P Remote ATGM Team
units.advantage: Remote screen console operating up to 50 meters from the launcher keeps the crew safely inside trenches.
units.disadvantage: Setup time required to deploy the tripod and fiber-optic cable spool.
units.description: Laser-guided anti-tank missile system famous for piercing heavy explosive reactive armor from defilade.

units.name: T-84 Oplot-M Main Battle Tank
units.advantage: Duplet multilayer explosive reactive armor defeats tandem-charge warheads and APFSDS darts.
units.disadvantage: Requires specialized spare parts for the 6TD-2E opposed-piston diesel engine.
units.description: Ukrainian advanced main battle tank with panoramic PNK-6 hunter-killer sight and 125mm gun.

units.name: Strv 103C "S-Tank" Defilade Master
units.advantage: Turretless hull design with extreme 12-degree glacis plate slope causes kinetic shells to ricochet harmlessly.
units.disadvantage: Cannot fire while turning without aiming the entire vehicle hull.
units.description: Ingenious Swedish Cold War tank with autoloader (15 rounds/min) and dual gas-turbine/diesel powertrain.

units.name: CV9040C Bofors 40mm IFV
units.advantage: 40mm Bofors L/70 autocannon firing 3P programmable high-explosive fragmentation shells.
units.disadvantage: Smaller troop dismount capacity (6 infantry) compared to wheeled troop carriers.
units.description: Swedish armored infantry fighting vehicle renowned for its powerful heavy autocannon and MEXAS armor.

units.name: SAS Infiltration Recon Team
units.advantage: Deep infiltration behind hostile lines; plants electronic spoofers and calls precision airstrikes.
units.disadvantage: Minimal body armor protection against heavy caliber direct machine gun fire.
units.description: Special Air Service reconnaissance operators specializing in covert perimeter penetration and tactical demolition.

units.name: ROKN UDT/SEAL Commando
units.advantage: Amphibious coastal raids and counter-terrorism breaching in fortified urban terrain.
units.disadvantage: Limited sustained firepower without armored mechanized support.
units.description: South Korean naval special warfare operator trained for rapid demolition and high-value target capture.

units.name: Foreign Legion Combat Sapper
units.advantage: Heavy combat breaching charges and mine clearing line charges (MICLIC) under fire.
units.disadvantage: Heavily laden with explosive charges, lowering sprint endurance.
units.description: French Foreign Legion 1er REG combat engineer specializing in explosive breaching of fortified obstacles.

units.name: Stryker ICVD 30mm Dragoon
units.advantage: MCT-30 unmanned turret with 30mm Mk44 Bushmaster II gun providing superior standoff range.
units.disadvantage: High center of gravity requires careful cornering on uneven off-road slopes.
units.description: US Army 8x8 infantry carrier upgraded with an unmanned 30mm cannon turret for mechanized brigade combat teams.

buildings.name: FOB Strategic Command Center
buildings.description: Central tactical command node coordinating radar detection, squad capacities, and anti-tamper security.

buildings.name: Phalanx CIWS 20mm Gatling
buildings.description: Radar-guided 20mm M61 Vulcan rotary cannon shooting down incoming artillery shells and rockets.

buildings.name: Hardened 155mm Ballistic Emplacement
buildings.description: Long-range armored gun emplacement providing over-the-horizon defensive bombardment.

buildings.name: Patriot Advanced SAM Silo
buildings.description: Surface-to-air missile battery providing an impenetrable shield against airstrikes and gunships.

buildings.name: Armored Fusion-Diesel Generator
buildings.description: Produces 85 MW of power to sustain defense turrets, radar sensors, and shield grids.

buildings.name: Automated Munitions Foundry
buildings.description: Fabricates high-caliber kinetic sabot rounds, mortar charges, and autocannon belts.

buildings.name: Hardened Underground Fuel Bladder
buildings.description: Stores JP-8 refined turbine fuel and synthetic cell reserves for tanks and gunships.

buildings.name: Bio-Sustainment Hydroponic Bay
buildings.description: Produces enriched field rations to maintain operator morale and combat reaction speed.

buildings.name: DARPA Experimental Armory Lab
buildings.description: Researches transition from Cold War weapons into futuristic hyper-railguns and laser defense.
